item.title: Pantograph 1.1.6
item.description:
New

  • Convert to JPEG. File › Convert to JPEG (⇧⌘J), or right-click a photo, saves a JPEG copy of a HEIC (or any other photo) beside the original, which is left untouched. The copy looks the same and keeps the photo's date, location and colour profile. Expect it to be about twice the size of a HEIC: JPEG simply compresses less well. For a different quality or format, use Save As.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself. Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.6.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
